title: Transport transformation demands capital investment, not higher fares
description: Raising public transport costs during an ongoing cost-of-living crisis fails citizens and defies good sense. When fares are lower, people can move around more easily, reducing reliance on cars. By pushing through fare increases, the Government sends a clear, damaging message to every non-driver in the country.The Taoiseach has said transport fares have to rise in order for services to be expanded.
